tac_height_from_shading — 2D tactile op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "tac_height_from_shading", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

Usage

Height/relief map by Poisson integration of the shading gradients -- the integration stage of GelSight depth reconstruction (and of photometric stereo): the image gradients are read as surface slopes `p = gain*gx, q = gain*gy and the Poisson equation lap(h) = div(p,q) is solved spectrally, h_hat = div_hat / lap_hat with the discrete Laplacian symbol 2cos(2*pi*u/W)+2cos(2*pi*v/H)-4 and the (undetermined) DC mode pinned to zero. a = gradient gain (0.25..4.25x), b` = pre-smoothing sigma of the gradient field (0..3). Output is min-max normalised to [0,1] and refit to HxW; a constant frame integrates to a flat (all-zero) relief.
